description: Land Acquisition - Gangulwitiya, Elapatha D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (extents, boundaries, lot numbers, and locations) being acquired for public purpose, includes claimant information, and outlines compensation procedures. This content fits precisely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
